segments.name: AI-based processing and video and image processing SoC solutions
segments.description: Developer of low-power AI-based and video image processing system-on-chip semiconductors for edge AI and physical AI applications.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating and reportable segment and derives substantially all of its revenue from development and sales of low-power AI-based processing and video and image processing SoC solutions.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase SoC semiconductors for integration into their products including security cameras, automotive systems, robots, and consumer devices.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are used in a wide variety of human viewing, computer vision for edge and physical AI applications, including a variety of video security cameras, automotive camera systems, fixed robots, autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), industrial applications, intelligent transportation systems, and consumer devices, such as action, drone and 360° cameras.
